def: Adapting a weight matrix by learning one scale per singular value while keeping its singular vectors fixed, which needs far fewer parameters than LoRA.
A stored vector of singular-value scales trained for one domain, which can be mixed with others to configure the model for a task.
A scheme in which a first pass identifies the task and chooses a blend of expert vectors, and a second pass generates the answer with the adapted weights.
A model that changes part of its own weights at inference time in response to the task it is given, without a new training run.
A network whose output is the weights of another network.
A hypernetwork that generates LoRA matrices for a base model in one forward pass from a natural-language description of the task.
Training a hypernetwork to reproduce adapters that were already trained on known tasks, a form of distillation from adapters into a generator.
Producing an adapter for a task the generator was not trained on, from its description alone and without task data.
